clues.title: THE BETA PLAQUE
clues.caption: The chest plaque reads lnd 0.4-beta. It identifies the specific software release, anchoring the scene to Lightning Labs' first mainnet beta rather than the invention of Lightning itself.

clues.title: THE HANGING DATE
clues.caption: The tag reads 15 MAR 2018, the release announcement's date. It records this milestone, not the date of the first Lightning idea or the first payment ever made.

clues.title: THE BITCOIN CLASPS
clues.caption: Two Bitcoin clasp halves are joined by light. They suggest the two participants in a funded channel, whose balances can change off-chain while their channel remains anchored to Bitcoin's blockchain.

clues.title: THE SPHINX BRACER
clues.caption: The engraved Sphinx nods to the Sphinx-derived packet format used for Lightning onion routing. Layered instructions guide a payment through its route. The mythical engraving is an artistic clue, not actual networking equipment.
